messages:
alex: heads-up: noticed ~120 users got deprovisioned from prod-app after yesterday's RBAC role rename. SCIM logs show a PATCH that set `roles: []` for a bunch of users. anyone see an automated job?

nina: yikes. which provider for that tenant? Okta or AAD? any SAML claim changes in the deploy?

alex: Okta tenant `enterprise-west`. No SAML change in deploy, but there was a config rollout to mapping service at 1717552000 that renamed role `app_admin_v1` -> `app_admin`. mapping service log excerpt: 
```
2026-04-03T09:40:12Z mapping INFO update mapping for tenant enterprise-west: role app_admin_v1 -> app_admin
2026-04-03T09:40:12Z mapping DEBUG emitting scim patch payload for user u-123: {"Operations":[{"op":"replace","path":"roles","value":[]}]} 
```

raj: wait why `value: []`? mapping should emit a rename, not clear roles. maybe bug in mapping when old role missing. Did it hit provisioner or did idp-proxy mutate it?

ops-oncall: provisioner received patch and returned 200 for many calls. we have audit trail: `SCIM PATCH user u-123 by service mapping/runner-57`. No KMS errors in those timestamps. However there are KMS audit entries right after for a different flow: `kms: ReEncrypt failed: NotAuthorizedException` from the migration worker 1717559800. likely unrelated but worth noting.

security-bot: notice: key alias "alias/extid-migration" had policy tightened 1717559500 (https://audit.redwood.internal/kms/policy/1717559500). change removed AWSPrincipals for `migration-worker` role. :warning:

sre: can we get full SCIM patch content? looks like mapping emitted empty when it couldn't find mapping for old role. maybe mapping service falls back to empty array. if mapping service runs periodically, it could have re-applied empty roles across users.

alex: full patch (sanitized):
```
PATCH /scim/v2/Users/u-123
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],
  "Operations": [
    {"op":"replace","path":"roles","value":[]}
  ]
}
```

nina: if mapping couldn't resolve new role name it should have skipped, not emit a replace with empty. that's a severe bug. we should add a guard.

raj: agree. quick mitigation: block mapping-runner from writing SCIM patches until fix. we can flip a feature-flag. also run a compensating job to re-add roles for affected users. do we have a list?

ops-oncall: extracted affected users via audit: query returned 118 unique user IDs across 3 tenants. I'll assemble CSV and hand to product-security for re-provisioning consent.

security-bot: creating incident ticket SEC-2026-052 and assigning to @alex @nina @ops-oncall for triage. link: https://issues.redwood.internal/SEC-2026-052 :rotating_light:

sre: note about KMS: even though ReEncrypt NotAuthorized happened for migration-worker, that prevented the extid rewrap job for a small subset of tenants earlier. safe to say the deprovision root cause is mapping bug, but we should patch migration-worker policy back to allow rewrap only with strict conditions. open PR for key policy change rollback: https://stash.redwood.internal/p/kms/+/2200

alex: short-term plan:
- flip mapping-runner feature flag to read-only (nina)
- run compensating SCIM PATCH to restore roles for affected users (ops-oncall + product-security)
- postmortem & tests: require mapping service to emit no-op instead of empty list when role mapping missing (raj)
- review KMS key policy tightening that removed migration-worker permission (security team)

nina: flipping flag now. pulling mapping-runner logs to see why it emitted empty.

ops-oncall: I've queued a restore job in staging to verify restore PATCH semantics (will run in prod after signoff).

security-bot: added timeline stub to incident SEC-2026-052 and attached KMS policy diff.

alex: thanks. also add an alert rule: on SCIM PATCH where roles length < previous length by > 1 within 5m, page oncall. will open alert PR.

raj: and add unit test to mapping service: when old role missing, output should be a `noop` and log warning not produce replace-empty. patch incoming.

nina: FYI I found a related minor issue: idp-proxy normalizes SAML entitlements by splitting on `;` but some tenants send comma-separated lists. mapping service mis-parse could produce empty arrays. ticket opened: https://issues.redwood.internal/DEV-4337

alex: ok keep the channel updated. once restore finishes we'll validate with product-security and close incident. :thumbsup:
